_: How many tests each blocking suite has to pass before its exit 0 counts. Read by scripts/floor.mjs. A `+db` key is the same gate given a DATABASE_URL, which unskips its live cases; a gate without one shares a single floor, which is only safe while it fails rather than skips when the database is missing. Both tenancy suites do. Raise a number when a suite grows; lowering one is a deliberate act that belongs in the same commit as the cases it removes.
